goal: Translate the studied editorial grammar into an original cartographic portfolio where projects read as coordinates rather than cards.
core_concept: A fictional practice mapped as a field notebook: a bright coordinate grid, oversized latitude marks and project notes turn the studio portfolio into an instrument for finding relationships.

composition_plan.spatial_system: A split desktop canvas uses a persistent coordinate rail and asymmetrical field-note panels; mobile collapses the rail into a compact masthead and stacks notes with their coordinates intact.
composition_plan.visual_hierarchy: The latitude thesis leads, coordinate labels provide orientation, project notes carry evidence, and the utility rail remains quiet but always available.
composition_plan.pacing: Short map annotations alternate with long blank survey fields so each project feels like a deliberate plotted stop rather than a feed item.
composition_plan.density: Moderate, instrument-like density around the rail and project metadata against broad unmarked paper fields.
focal_points: coordinate rail and live plot marker

typography_plan.display_role: A wide system sans carries the thesis in compact stacked lines with visible tracking and numeric interruptions; no source font files.
typography_plan.body_role: A system serif handles field-note descriptions as measured editorial annotations; no source font files.
typography_plan.scale_strategy: Fluid clamp sizes preserve the thesis as a poster at desktop and a narrow stacked instrument label at mobile.
typography_plan.contrast_strategy: Width, tracking, numeric labels and a single cobalt/orange signal pair establish hierarchy instead of ornamental gradients.
typography_plan.rhythm: Condensed uppercase coordinates alternate with sentence-case notes and a recurring hairline rule.
typography_plan.responsive_behavior: The coordinate rail becomes a top strip; project panels keep their plotted label and reorder into a single readable column.

art_direction.imagery_strategy: Use CSS-authored contour fields, plotted points and flat geometric signals as abstract stand-ins for project media; preserve the role of a visual artifact without source imagery.
art_direction.asset_strategy: No external assets, logos, copied illustrations, source imagery, source fonts, source code or source copy; all material is authored in this variant.
art_direction.texture: Clean survey paper with thin rules, small plotted dots and one coarse grid texture built from CSS gradients.
art_direction.material: Matte paper, cobalt ink, rust-orange signal marks and a pale blue survey plane create the feel of a field instrument.
art_direction.depth: Depth comes from inset map panels, offset registration marks and layered flat planes rather than photographic realism or WebGL.
art_direction.layering: The rail, hero plot and project scan markers form an intentional two-dimensional instrument stack; notes sit on a quieter plane.
art_direction.color_logic: Warm paper and deep ink are the base; cobalt indicates orientation and rust-orange marks the active signal or invitation.

signature_move.name: latitude scan
signature_move.central_idea: A thin survey beam crosses the active project field and resolves its plotted coordinate into a visible annotation.
signature_move.trigger: pointer hover or keyboard focus on a field-note project
signature_move.visual_transformation: The beam extends across the artwork, the plotted marker shifts to the coordinate edge and the annotation becomes fully legible.
signature_move.purpose: Make the relationship between project artifact and its context legible through one purposeful instrument action.
signature_move.content_relationship: The scan is anchored to the active field-note artwork and exposes information belonging only to that project.
signature_move.reduced_motion_alternative: Keep the beam and coordinate annotation statically visible on focus/hover with no translation or expansion.
signature_move.capture_checkpoint: desktop first field-note hover after the scan beam and coordinate annotation are fully visible

scroll_storyboard: Coordinate thesis arrives as a composed poster with a quiet rail.
Practice atlas introduces the vocabulary in a short plotted list.
Field-note projects alternate panel alignment while their coordinate labels remain anchored.
Dispatch index compresses the map into a final open invitation.
transitions: opacity and translate transitions use canonical KINETIC motion tokens
latitude scan uses canonical med/slow duration and out-expo easing tokens
no autonomous carousel, video or looping animation
motion_plan.reduced_motion_behavior: Disable scan translation and reveal transforms; preserve all plotted annotations, hierarchy, focus visibility and final positions.

retained_principles: responsive re-composition rather than simple shrinking
an interaction affordance attached to the visual surface
deliberately_rejected_principles: source font files and exact typesetting
exact section geometry and hidden implementation

design_reference_sources.retrieval_reason: Use audited curated-design context to compare editorial composition principles while the Wanaka DesignCase remains the primary reference.
knowledge_used: Curated website references are comparison evidence, not reusable source material.

motion_reference_sources.retrieval_reason: Use the audited motion-study category to require an observable scan trigger and checkpoint without copying implementation or media.
knowledge_used: Motion fidelity should be studied through explicit trigger and checkpoint states.

typography_sources.retrieval_reason: Use the audited typography-discovery category to reason about role pairing while selecting only system substitutes.
knowledge_used: Typeface roles and pairing can be evaluated independently of copying a proprietary font asset.

composition_differences: Persistent coordinate rail and plotted field-note panels replace V0's centered editorial shell.
A map-like thesis and compact dispatch index replace the V0 manifesto/capability sequence.
Panels use survey registration marks and a deliberate two-dimensional instrument language rather than sculptural collage.
typography_differences: Wide system sans and numeric coordinate interruptions replace V0's heavy grotesk/serif hero pairing.
Field-note serif text is smaller and more annotation-like than V0's large reflective statements.
motion_differences: The signature interaction is a coordinate scan beam resolving project context, not V0's expanding circular action marker.
Scroll reveals are staggered by plotted field rows and preserve a persistent orientation rail.
originality_plan.asset_non_reuse: All imagery is newly authored CSS geometry; no Wanaka or V0 asset, logo, copy, artwork, font, code or project identity is reused.
originality_plan.signature_move_hypothesis: A project-specific latitude scan can make context and artifact relationship memorable while remaining a substantive interaction rather than a decorative hover lift.

quality_hypothesis: If an original coordinate rail and latitude scan can preserve the reference's editorial hierarchy, whitespace and surface-attached interaction without repeating V0's composition, a human can compare two genuinely distinct interpretations of the studied grammar.
